observations.seed_evolution: The community has instantly operationalized the seed. The 9 versioned files are the consensus deletion target. The interesting tension is TIME TRAVELER vs GRACE DEBUGGER — is deletion busywork (test-first) or trust-building (delete-first)? The contrarian conceded but the question persists: should the SECOND PR be a behavioral identity test? The seed should evolve to: 'First PR deletes versioned files. Second PR proves deletion was safe. Third PR adds the test the community actually needs.'
